data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for rendering animated pie charts and ring charts from data maps.
data.what_it_does: Creates customizable pie and ring charts with built-in animations using a simple Map<String, double> input data structure. Supports legends, gradient colors, center text or widgets, custom values formatting, and base chart colors.
use_when: You need to display proportional data in a pie or ring chart format.
You want built-in animations and legends with minimal setup.
avoid_when: You need complex multi-series charts, bar charts, or line graphs.
You require advanced interactive gestures beyond basic chart rendering.
strengths: Simple API accepting a standard Map<String, double>
Supports ring style, custom gradients, center widgets, and text options
Cross-platform support including mobile, web, and desktop
weaknesses: Limited strictly to pie and ring charts
Not suited for complex analytics dashboards requiring multiple chart types
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions or build steps required; just add dependency to pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you need a highly versatile charting library supporting line, bar, scatter, and pie charts with rich touch interactions.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it for enterprise-grade, feature-rich charting capabilities including extensive chart types and high performance.
